completeness_basis: Every endpoint heading (h1 with an HTTP method) on the seven v1.19 API pages plus every normative module/section heading for homeserver behaviour, every room version page v1-v12 (5 components each) and every appendix section is enumerated. Endpoint list was machine-extracted from the published HTML (client-server 164 incl. 9 deprecated, server-server 36, application-service 11, push-gateway 1, identity-service 23); a TOC cross-check found no omissions.

status_legend.implemented+tested: Route/behaviour present and asserted by at least one named test (semantic completeness may still be tracked by the listed beads only when status is partial).
status_legend.implemented-untested: Present but no test asserts it.
status_legend.partial: Present with known spec deviations or missing sub-features; see gap_beads.
status_legend.not-applicable: Not a homeserver obligation (justification in notes).

method: Routes extracted from conduit-server/src (axum .route calls incl. nested federation router); tests matched by literal paths/handler names in test bodies with method disambiguation, then curated. Statuses for implemented items were reviewed against handler code; partial means a concrete deviation is known.

items.title: Guest access
items.notes: A room admits guests only while m.room.guest_access is can_join. When that state stops admitting guests, whether the change was local or accepted over federation, joined local guests leave and cannot rejoin. Registered members stay.

items.title: Room previews (world_readable reads without joining)
items.notes: GET /events?room_id and rooms/{roomId}/initialSync peek world_readable rooms; non-world_readable events are filtered per event.

items.notes: whois, lock, suspend. Conduit admin API also under /_matrix/conduit/admin/v1 (non-spec).

items.title: Direct messaging (is_direct on createRoom invites)
items.notes: createRoom is_direct sets is_direct on the invite member event, visible in the invitee invite_state.

items.title: Invite permission (M_INVITE_BLOCKED)
items.notes: default_action=block returns 403 M_INVITE_BLOCKED from POST /invite, createRoom, PUT m.room.member invite, and federation PUT /invite on v1 and v2. A refused federation invite is not stored. Pending invites are hidden from /sync and return when blocking is cleared.

items.title: Sticker messages
items.notes: Client-only; m.sticker is stored and served like any room event.

items.title: OpenID (request_token + federation userinfo)
items.notes: request_token mints a hashed bearer bound to the user; federation userinfo returns that user as sub.

items.title: Server ACLs for rooms
items.notes: A denied origin receives 403 on the federation participation endpoints and a per-PDU error on /send; its typing and receipt EDUs are ignored. Inviting a user on a denied server is 403 before any outbound request. Replacing the deny list restores access. Globs, ports, and allow_ip_literals follow the v1.19 order.

items.title: User and room mentions (m.mentions push rules)
items.notes: m.mentions user_ids highlight; room mentions highlight only with sender_notification_permission room.

items.title: Room upgrades
items.notes: Server behaviour: permission, predecessor create, transferable state, local aliases, tombstone, lockdown. additional_creators come from the upgrade body. Per-user tags and room push rules copy when the user joins the replacement.

items.title: Server notices
items.notes: One room per user (tag m.server_notice), invite not auto-join, msgtype m.server_notice, M_CANNOT_LEAVE_SERVER_NOTICE_ROOM on invite rejection, re-invite after leave; admin trigger POST /_matrix/conduit/admin/v1/server_notices. No usage limits exist, so usage_limit_reached notices are only sent manually.

items.title: Moderation policy lists
items.notes: Spec: "Servers have no additional requirements placed on them by this module." m.policy.rule.* are ordinary state events.

items.title: Policy servers (client behaviour of homeserver)
items.notes: Before a client event is stored, an enabled policy server (via plus ed25519, and a joined user on via) is asked to sign it. m.room.policy with an empty state key is not sent for signing. A refusal is returned with the policy server's status and error, and the event is not stored. An invalid signature is requested once more. Incoming federation soft-fail remains ss.policy-servers.

items.title: Server ACLs enforcement
items.notes: Denied origins are rejected on the MUST endpoints (state, state_ids, backfill, get_missing_events, event_auth, make_join, send_join, make_leave, send_leave, make_knock, send_knock, invite) and on /send per PDU. Typing and receipt EDUs from a denied origin are dropped. Lifting the deny list restores the previously allowed requests.

items.title: Policy servers (homeserver obligations in rooms using one)
items.notes: Client-authored events ask POST /_matrix/policy/v1/sign and keep a verifying ed25519:policy_server signature. Events received over federation without a valid policy signature are not yet soft-failed.

items.title: Adding hashes and signatures to outgoing events
items.notes: Byte-exact for typed v11 events; wire PDU model in conduit-embed-pdu.

items.title: Validating hashes and signatures on received events

items.title: Security considerations
items.notes: Informative guidance.

items.title: Registration (YAML, namespaces, exclusive, url null, rate_limited, protocols)
items.notes: receive_ephemeral (+MSC2409 alias) and rate_limited honoured; url null, protocols, exclusive namespaces.

items.title: Homeserver->AS authorisation (Authorization: Bearer hs_token)
items.notes: Every homeserver->AS request (transactions, user/alias queries, ping, third-party) carries Authorization: Bearer hs_token; the query token is only sent on the legacy-route fallback.

items.title: Legacy route fallback (SHOULD)
items.notes: On 404/405 from /_matrix/app/v1/* the unprefixed legacy route is tried with ?access_token; the current route is retried first on every request. 5xx is treated as an outage (backoff), not as an unknown route.

items.title: Unknown routes (AS answers M_UNRECOGNIZED)
items.notes: Obligation on the application service, not the homeserver.

items.title: Pushing events (interest rules, txn retry, ordering)
items.notes: Interest: rooms namespace, any room alias (directory + canonical alt_aliases), local namespace/sender user as sender, member target or joined member. Linearised by stream position, one transaction in flight, exactly-once across restart. Interest is evaluated on current room state.

items.title: Pushing ephemeral data (receive_ephemeral)
items.notes: receive_ephemeral (and the MSC2409 alias): m.typing and m.receipt with room_id under room interest, private receipts only for namespace users, m.presence when the user is interesting or shares an interesting room. Typing/presence cursors are process-local (stores are in-memory).

items.title: Querying users and aliases
items.notes: Retries several times on network error/5xx before giving up. conduit-c3u: negative cache (performance, not conformance).

items.title: Identity assertion (user_id / device_id masquerading)
items.notes: as_token accepted by every AuthedUser endpoint; ?user_id defaults to the sender user, must be registered and in the users namespace (403 M_FORBIDDEN); ?device_id (v1.17, MSC3202 name accepted) must belong to the user (400 M_UNKNOWN_DEVICE); device-less otherwise.

items.title: Timestamp massaging (ts)
items.notes: ?ts on PUT send/state for as_token requests sets origin_server_ts (task-local override in the event pipeline); invalid ts is 400 M_INVALID_PARAM; ignored for ordinary users.

items.title: Server admin style permissions (namespace registration, rate-limit exemption, M_EXCLUSIVE)
items.notes: /register with type m.login.application_service (401 without/unknown as_token), M_EXCLUSIVE for users and aliases (PUT /directory/room, createRoom room_alias_name), sender and non-rate_limited masquerades exempt from CS rate limits. Legacy login is supported, so M_APPSERVICE_LOGIN_UNSUPPORTED never applies.

items.title: Using /sync and /events as AS users
items.notes: /sync works for virtual users through identity assertion.

items.title: Device management for AS users (create via PUT, delete without UIA)
items.notes: PUT /devices/{id} creates (201) for AS; DELETE /devices/{id} and POST /delete_devices skip UIA for AS.

items.title: Cross-signing uploads without UIA for AS users
items.notes: Replacement cross-signing uploads skip UIA for application services.

items.title: Referencing messages from a third-party network
items.notes: Event-content convention for bridges (external_url); no homeserver behaviour.

items.title: Homeserver behaviour: notify payload, counts, devices, prio, format=event_id_only, rejected pushkeys
items.notes: Exponential backoff for 24h, 4xx drops, rejected removal, event_id_only. Gateway URLs are not SSRF-filtered (y99.31.1).

items.title: Unsupported endpoints (gateway side)
items.notes: Obligation on the push gateway.

items.title: Homeserver interaction model with identity servers (id_server + id_access_token supplied by clients; HS proxies bind/unbind, lookup/store-invite for 3PID invites)
items.notes: Client-supplied id_server (hostname[:port], HTTPS) + id_access_token; lookup/store-invite for invites, bind/unbind proxy with remembered bindings. Requests go through the outbound SSRF policy (CONDUIT_IS_ALLOW_CIDRS to allow private ranges).

items.title: Room version 12: Redaction algorithm
items.notes: v12 redacts a message the same way as v11.

items.title: Room version 12: State resolution algorithm
items.notes: v12 iterative auth starts empty and includes the conflicted subgraph. v2 keeps an event v12 drops.

items.title: Room version 12: Canonical JSON / integer rules
items.notes: Version-independent canonical JSON implemented; v6+ integer-range enforcement shared with v11.

items.title: Room version grammar and feature matrix; advertise only supported versions
items.notes: Capabilities advertise room versions 1-12 as stable and default new rooms to 12. Version 13 is M_UNSUPPORTED_ROOM_VERSION.

items.title: Unpadded Base64 (encode unpadded, accept padded)
items.notes: Padded input acceptance unverified.

items.title: Binary data

items.title: User identifiers (+ historical user IDs)
items.notes: Localpart grammar enforced on registration; historical user IDs accepted for remote users is unverified (y99.40).

items.title: Event IDs
items.notes: v4+ format only.

items.title: Matrix URI scheme and matrix.to
items.notes: Client-side navigation.

items.title: 3PID types (email normalisation, E.164 msisdn)
items.notes: email: case-folded (lowercase plus the common full foldings such as ß->ss; not the complete Unicode CaseFolding table); msisdn: E.164 digits without '+'.

items.title: Glob-style matching (push rules, server ACLs)
items.notes: * matches zero or more characters and ? matches exactly one, for both push-rule globs and server ACL globs.

items.title: Dot-separated property paths (escaping)
items.notes: \. and \\ escapes; other backslash sequences literal.
